_README: Seeded once by the AI-Handbook sync, then owned by this repository. EDIT BOTH FIELDS BEFORE USE. Left as-is, the machinery refuses rather than guesses: every review request blocks with a message naming this file. That is the intended failure -- it announces itself instead of silently protecting nothing.
_repo: This repository's GitHub owner/name, exactly as the API spells it. Every receipt and snapshot check binds to it, and a review request whose target does not match it is REFUSED.
_baseBranch: The branch pull requests merge into. The required-checks policy below is read from THIS branch, never from the pull request under review, so that a pull request cannot weaken the gate that approves it.
_requiredChecks: The CI jobs that must be PRESENT before a readiness receipt is honest -- every job that can appear late, not only the ones that must pass. A job gated on an earlier one is created late, so a snapshot taken too early sees a complete green set without it. Use the jobs.*.name values from this repo's workflows.
